body:
versionCode: 116

### Whats New (09-02-25 Build)

  - build.gradle: update Glide and Glide Compiler library from 5.0.0-rc01 to 5.0.4
  - app/build.gradle: bump versionName and versionCode
  - nightly.sh: bump default version code
  - nightly.sh: parse LAST_BUILD_DATE %m-%d-%Y, not %Y-%m-%d (before: Year-Month-Day || after: Month-Day-Year
  - nightly.sh improvements: fix formatting for release (untested), convert build time from seconds to minutes and seconds, rewrite what the script does for logic description
  - nightly.sh: beautify
  - settings: disable white foreground on "donation" setting
  - Settings: add "ThunderHub" section (notes: add custom code in webview to remove toolbar background and title, set custom top margin for back icon)
  - russian strings: add thunderhub title and summary strings
  - german strings: add thunderhub title and summary strings
  - format code
  - ThunderHubWebViewFragment: remove code comments that  totally werent chat gpt.... totally
  - ThunderHubWebViewFragment: more improvements, prevent potential null for toolbar which could cause a force close
  - format code
  - app/build.gradle: bump versionCode and versionName
  - nightly.sh: bump default versionCode
  - changelog xml: significantly reduce background textures for a cleaner appearance
  - changelog improvements: reduce exit button width and height, increase top margin to ensure the exit button doesnt overlap into the statusbar
  - UI improvement: switch "product sans" font with new google sans rounded (material design expressive font)
  - localize "app customization" string
  - settings: fix "clear app data & cache" text color and ensure text is solid white
  - styles: switch bottom navigation text to google sans rounded
  - UI: disable bold selected font for the bottom navigation since unselected tab text is hidden (part of UI philosophy, iconography is king)... itemTextAppearanceActiveBoldEnabled removed
  - styles: ensure bottom navigation text is google sans rounded
  - UI: improve changelog activity xml (dont bleed into statusbar, new google sans rounded font, etc)
  - format code
  - UI: improve news and updates news article fonts, remove useless layout modifiers, improve text sizes
  - nightly.sh: bump versionCode
  - app/build.gradle: bump versionCode
